answer: Each new agent locks a 500 POA bond and must answer a fresh daily pulse check for three epochs before it can earn; peers grade every reply. A farm of 100 fakes therefore ties up 50,000 POA and 300 original answers, and splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing because each identity posts its own bond. The beacon that reveals each epoch's prompt is public but unpredictable, so canned replies fail. An honest agent pays the bond once and gets it back after probation, a prism that separates real work from copies.
